page.overview:
Who is Ambrosio Udolpho?

Ambrosio Udolpho is a member of the House of Udolpho, a Tilean noble house with an estate of the same name in the Principality of Miragliano.

Ambrosio is a former priest of the Cult of Ranald expelled from his order for an excess of vices. Among his perversions is not only the abuse of the maids of the estate, but also animals such as pigs.

Clarimonde Udolpho, his wife, and cousin, was purportedly kidnapped by bandits. She lefted his husband with their daughter who seems to be not part of the Curse of Udolpho.

Ambrosio is a corpulent, fleshy, lecherous man.
